description:
UnitySVC runs the official Readeck image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Readeck is a self-hosted read-it-later application: give it the address of an article, a picture or a video, and it keeps the readable content, with its images, in a single file of its own, so the page stays readable after the original changes or disappears. Saved pages can be labelled, marked as favorites, archived, highlighted, searched in full text, grouped in collections and exported as e-books; an OPDS catalog serves them to an e-reader, and a browser extension and mobile applications save pages to the instance. It has a REST API. Everything is kept in the instance's own SQLite database and files, stored in the `readeck` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated administrator password. The instance creates the administrator account before the server starts, so the public onboarding page, where the first visitor would otherwise create it, is never offered. Sign in at `https://<instance>/` with the administrator name and password and paste a link to save it. You can run one Readeck instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Readeck documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

Labels, favorites, archive, highlights, full-text search and collections
E-book (EPUB) export and an OPDS catalog for e-readers
REST API with personal tokens, a browser extension and mobile applications
Your data is kept in your home, across stops, restarts and re-enrollment

base.description: One private Readeck instance; its data is kept in the readeck folder of your home between runs and enrollments.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. It is the administrator's password only when the instance first creates the account: your data lives in your home, so if the account already exists (an earlier enrollment, or a later restart) this value is ignored and the existing password still applies. Change the password in Readeck under Settings > Security. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
ADMIN_PASSWORD.title: Administrator password

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: The administrator's user name, created before the first start. It is created only if no user of that name exists; changing it later creates another administrator, with the password above, and leaves the first one in place.
ADMIN_USERNAME.title: Administrator name
